[SWS_CM_90115] SecOC secure channel for methods using unreliable transport
⌈
A SecOC secure channel shall be created and used if:
• A SecOcSecureComProps instance is referenced in the role secureComPro-
psForUdp by a ServiceInstanceToMachineMapping and a method of the
AdaptivePlatformServiceInstance is selected for transmission over the
secured channel by the ServiceInterfaceElementSecureComConfig and
this method of the AdaptivePlatformServiceInstance is configured for
transmission over “tcp” by transportProtocol in the associated Someip-
MethodDeployment.
⌋
